title: Cycle 2.2: The Hollowpoint Hit
name: The Hollowpoint Hit
intro: Hollowpoint sits in a gutted manufactorum where the bullet-makers once worked, and some of them still do. At its heart the great Furnace still burns, melting down scrap brass for the casting benches. Cases are cast by hand and sold by the sack, and whoever holds the place decides who gets them.

{t:The Midnight Theatre} need it badly. The Rendermarch cost them dearly: Mungojerrie lies close to death, and Growltiger and Jellylorum are still nursing their wounds. With so few fighters left standing, the Theatre cannot afford to be outgunned, and Deuteronomy means to take the bullet works before the Psalm grow any stronger.

But the underhive keeps no secrets from {p:The Carrion Psalm} for long. Word of the Delaque's plan reaches Mordecai, and the Word Keeper leads his congregation into the ruins to meet them. Neither gang knows exactly where the other will come from. They will find each other in the dark.

facts: Plentiful Ammo: once per round, each gang may make a Reload action as a Free action.
2' × 2' - Deployment zones 6" from each corner rather than 9"

Chance Encounter: the winner of a roll-off chooses a corner. Their deployment zone is anywhere within 6" of that corner and the opposite corner; their opponent deploys within 6" of the other two corners. Starting crews are split as evenly as possible between each gang's two zones.

Object Lesson: in each End phase, gangs earn 1 VP for each enemy model that went Out of Action that round, +1 VP if it was a Leader, Champion or Brute, and +1 VP if it was taken Out of Action by a Fight, Coup de Grâce or Sabotage action. First to 10 VP wins.
{t:Crippling Strike:} in any End phase, at least half of the opponent's models on the battlefield are Seriously Injured or Engaged.
{p:Spread Unrest:} any Active non-Beast fighter performs the Graffiti (Double) action in the enemy deployment zone.

Strike Force: both gangs use Custom (5).
{t:Theatre:} 5 fighters plus Rumpus, 855 rating
{p:Psalm:} 5 fighters, 895 rating

text: {p:The Carrion Psalm} enter the bullet den through the casting hall and the ruins. The Furnace is still roaring at the heart of the works, and the heat comes off it in waves. Before the night is out, the Cawdor mean to mark their claim on the territory.

But {t:The Midnight Theatre} are hot on their tail, slipping in through the shell works and the magazine. Deuteronomy's orders are simple. The Theatre do not need to win this fight. They only need to leave the Cawdor bleeding in the dark, too many of them down or tied up to fight back.
{@macavity|Macavity} is nowhere to be seen. He stays hidden in the shadows, waiting for his moment.

map.label: Top-down map of the Cycle 2.2 table: the Furnace at the centre with the Anvil just south of it, containers to the north, the Casting hall, Shell works, Magazine and the ruins in the four corners, with the Carrion Psalm deploying in the Casting hall and ruins corners and the Midnight Theatre in the Shell works and Magazine corners.

text: {@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen} lumber up past the ruins to cover the Psalm's advance.
High in the shell works, {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} climbs up to the raised floor and takes a shot at the Stig-Shambler.
The shot goes wide, and the coils of the plasma gun burn out.
{@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} climbs up in the casting hall to get a fix on the Theatre's movements, and across the works {@demeter|Demeter} climbs the magazine to find a firing position.
{@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel Crows} moves up to the door of the casting hall, ready to advance with Gutter covering him.
In the shell works, {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} reaches into the dark and wraps himself in a Perfect Void.
He holds the silence in place with a second effort of will, then moves up beside {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser}.
{@mordecai|Mordecai} stacks up behind Ezekiel at the door.
{@rumpus|Rumpus} burrows out of the ground by the Anvil. In the magazine, {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} stays in cover.
{@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah Emberchoir} moves under the Anvil to hunt the Wyrd.

map.label: Positions at the end of round 1: Ezekiel, Mordecai and Gutter Cantor in the casting hall, Deus and Amen beside the ruins and Elijah under the Anvil; Deuteronomy and Rumpleteaser in the shell works, Mistoffelees and Demeter on the magazine and Rumpus by the Anvil.

caption.text: Positions at the end of round 1

text: {@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen} open up with the twin stubbers on the shell works, raking the raised floor where {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} is crouched over his dead plasma gun.

roll.name: Deus and Amen - Twin-linked Heavy Stubber

rows.note: Note: Bulging Biceps to move at Initiative and fire a heavy weapon. Twin-linked to re-roll the Rapid Fire dice.

text: From the top of the magazine, {@demeter|Demeter} takes careful aim at {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} in the casting hall.
{@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} fires back, but at {@rumpus|Rumpus}, scuttling between the barricades by the Anvil.
{@rumpus|Rumpus} creeps up under the Anvil, close to the Stig-Shambler. In the magazine, {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} reaches out to {@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen} with the Terrible Truths.
This time the whispers find a way in. Amen's great head swings from side to side, and Deus can't settle him.
{@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah Emberchoir} turns his autopistol on {@rumpus|Rumpus}.
In the shell works, {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} keeps his Perfect Void in place.
He moves to {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser}'s side and fires down at the Stig-Shambler.
{@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel Crows} advances out of the casting hall.
With Deuteronomy beside him, {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} binds his wounds and drags himself back up.

rows.note: Note: +1 die from the Tend Wounds action, +1 die from Deuteronomy assisting. Rumpleteaser has taken a wound and is Injured.

text: {@mordecai|Mordecai} follows Ezekiel out.

map.label: Positions at the end of round 2: Gutter Cantor in the casting hall, Mordecai and Ezekiel advancing down the west side, Deus and Amen by the Anvil and Elijah under it; Rumpleteaser and Deuteronomy together in the shell works, Mistoffelees and Demeter on the magazine and Rumpus under the Anvil.

caption.text: Positions at the end of round 2

text: {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel Crows} breaks from cover and charges {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} at the foot of the magazine. He doesn't get far. On the roof above, {@demeter|Demeter} has been waiting on overwatch.

roll.name: Demeter - Overwatch
roll.result: Ezekiel takes 1 wound and is suppressed

text: Under the Anvil, {@rumpus|Rumpus} throws himself at {@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah Emberchoir}.
{@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} slips along the wall of the magazine and turns the Terrible Truths on Ezekiel, but the words won't come.
From the casting hall, {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} fires on {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser}.
{@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} holds the Perfect Void in place.
Then he takes careful aim at the Stig-Shambler.
{@mordecai|Mordecai} sees Ezekiel fall short and goes in himself, charging {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees}.
Deuteronomy's shot has marked the target. {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} reloads the plasma gun, plays Crossfire and puts a plasma bolt into {@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen}.

roll.name: Rumpleteaser - Plasma Gun
roll.result: Deus and Amen take 2 wounds and are suppressed

rows.note: Note: Crossfire, so the shot hits automatically.

text: Under the Anvil, {@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah Emberchoir} turns on {@rumpus|Rumpus} again.

rows.note: Note: Rumpus suffers a Grievous Wound.

text: The chainaxe bites twice, and the Lurker goes down.
{@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen} are still in the grip of the Terrible Truths. Deus is sure the shadows are watching them.

rows.note: Note: Insanity result "The Shadows Have Eyes!".

text: They recoil in fear from the shadows and step back out into the clearing.

map.label: Positions at the end of round 3: Gutter Cantor in the casting hall, Ezekiel and Mordecai at the magazine with Mordecai engaged with Mistoffelees, Demeter on the magazine, Deus and Amen east of the Furnace and Elijah under the Anvil where Rumpus lies out of action; Rumpleteaser and Deuteronomy in the shell works.

caption.text: Positions at the end of round 3

text: {@deus-and-amen|Deus and Amen} shake off the shadows and turn the twin stubbers back on the shell works, where {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} is still nursing his wounds.

roll.name: Deus and Amen - Twin-linked Heavy Stubber

text: Out of nowhere, {@macavity|Macavity} is moving. He rushes towards the Cawdor leader, wanting to finish what he started at the Pyroclave.
At the foot of the magazine, {@mordecai|Mordecai} keeps hacking at {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees}.
{@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} holds the Perfect Void in place and moves to get a shot on the Stig-Shambler.
{@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel Crows} charges {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} again. Again, {@demeter|Demeter} is watching from the roof.

rows.note: Note: Knockback (6+), a hit roll of 6 knocks the target 1" back. Overwatch finishes Ezekiel's activation.

text: In the shell works, {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} crawls to Deuteronomy's side.
{@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} climbs down from the casting hall to try and reach Ezekiel and give him aid.
{@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} disengages from Mordecai.
{@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah Emberchoir} reloads his autopistol and advances to the fray.

map.label: Positions at the end of round 4: Gutter Cantor down from the casting hall, Ezekiel seriously injured and Mordecai below him by the magazine, Deus and Amen by the Anvil and Elijah advancing south of the magazine; Macavity out of hiding by the containers, Rumpleteaser seriously injured beside Deuteronomy in the shell works, Demeter on the magazine and Mistoffelees free inside it.
